methodology: Twelve real field recordings, eleven CC0 Freesound HQ previews and one Public Domain SoundBible fireplace distributed by Blanket, plus three original generated colored noises. No synthesis or noise reduction for recordings. Sample-exact cyclic equal-power overlap; constant gain; MP3 highest VBR quality with Xing/LAME gapless metadata. Only user-requested wind receives a static -5dB treble shelf at 2500Hz. Colored noise retains its original cyclic master. Loudness filter is measurement-only, with output discarded. Technical metrics do not constitute listening approval.
toolVersion: ffmpeg version 9.0.1-essentials_build-www.gyan.dev Copyright (c) 2000-2026 the FFmpeg developers
limitations: Technical decoding and level checks are not a listening test. HQ MP3 source previews, not original WAV masters. Background playback on physical phones is not verified.
